newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairies to see sunny skies, cold weather.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairies to see sunny skies, cold weather.

text.p: Canada's Prairies on Tuesday were forecast to see sunny skies but cold temperatures, Environment Canada said.
Alberta was forecast to see mainly sunny skies with highs of -5 Celsius to 0 Celsius.
Saskatchewan was forecast to see partly sunny skies with highs of -12 to -7 Celsius.
Manitoba was forecast to see mainly sunny skies with highs of -13 to -7 Celsius.
